title.quote: DEUP: Direct Epistemic Uncertainty Prediction Salem Lahlou∗

extractions.description: The paper presents a framework called Direct Epistemic Uncertainty Prediction (DEUP) for estimating epistemic uncertainty in machine learning models. It critiques traditional Bayesian methods and proposes an alternative approach by estimating excess risk. This method is shown to be particularly useful in interactive and reinforcement learning environments, improving decision-making processes by providing better uncertainty estimates.
